title: swissValet
text: swissValet turns inspection functions type dozens times day single keystrokes. addin takes current selection RStudio editor, wraps corresponding call executes immediately console. Select mtcars, press shortcut, str(mtcars) runs — copying, typing, losing selection. package contains interactive dialogs selecting variables sorting code elements, converters Unicode characters escape sequences, routine writes existing object back editor reproducible source code. 📖 Repository: https://github.com/AndriSignorell/swissValet/

swissValet (development version)
text: RStudio addins apply frequently used inspection functions current editor selection execute console: xStrX(), xSummary(), xHead(), xDesc(), xAbstract(), xExample(), xPlot(), xUnclass() xxlView(). flushToSource() writes selected object back document reproducible source code; data frames rendered readable data.frame(...) call rather dput() output. selectVarDlg() opens interactive dialog choosing elements, factor levels data frame columns returns corresponding R expression, also copied clipboard. toggleUnicodeAddin(), escapeUnicode() unescapeUnicode() convert Unicode characters escape sequences. () returns random subset vector, matrix data frame, counterpart head() tail().
